name: Brand Authority Outcome Intro
use_when: An intro needs to make a creator, show, course, or community feel premium quickly.
The edit has real social proof, community proof, authority proof, or a strong third-party quote.
The viewer must understand who this is, why to trust it, and what outcome they can expect.
avoid_when: There is no truthful authority, proof, or outcome to show.
The intro would become self-praise instead of viewer value.
The content promise is already urgent and brand packaging would slow it down.
The proof source is irrelevant, unknown to the target niche, or misleading.

timeline_pattern.branding_rule: Show the brand, show name, creator identity, or series label clearly before visual complexity takes over.
timeline_pattern.authority_rule: Use third-party proof, recognized niche figures, community reaction, or client/audience evidence instead of direct self-praise.
timeline_pattern.outcome_rule: End the intro with the value the viewer expects to gain, not only a creator flex.
timeline_pattern.compression_rule: The three beats should fit the platform duration cap; remove the weakest beat rather than making the intro drag.

motion.rule: Motion should guide the viewer from brand to proof to outcome with one primary focus at a time.

sound.rule: Use music and SFX to raise perceived quality, but do not bury the proof quote or outcome line.

captions.rule: Use designed text for brand, proof, and outcome. Suppress ordinary captions when they duplicate the designed words.

color.rule: Use brand-consistent color and contrast; proof clips or quotes should remain readable and credible.

implementation.ffmpeg: Build timed sections for logo/show text, proof clip or quote text, and outcome phrase. Use drawtext/overlay/fades and render a short proof-of-readability preview.
implementation.remotion: Create IntroBeat data with type values brand, proof, outcome, startFrame, endFrame, text, sourceClipId, authorityLevel, and safeRegion.
implementation.blender: Use simple branded text and 3D/logo movement only when it clarifies the premium identity.
implementation.capcut_equivalent: Use a short logo/title card, proof clip or quote, and outcome text; compound the intro and trim to 3-5 seconds for social.
implementation.premiere_equivalent: Use a nested intro sequence with markers for brand, proof, and outcome; add Essential Graphics text and SFX markers for each beat.

common_mistakes: Opening with only a logo and no viewer value.
Having the creator claim authority instead of showing proof from someone else.
Using irrelevant celebrity or client proof that the target audience does not trust.
Ending the intro without making the viewer's expected outcome clear.
Making all three beats visually loud so none of them reads.
qc: Can the viewer identify the brand or show within the intro?
Is the authority proof truthful, relevant, and externally supported?
Does the intro state or imply the viewer outcome before the body starts?
Does each beat have one primary visual focus?
Does the proof quote remain audible/readable under music and SFX?
